title: AiMedOrchestra
summary: AiMedOrchestra is a multi-agent conversational system that simulates a virtual AI hospital, with specialist agents for diagnostics, imaging, genomics, trial matching, and synthetic patient generation. Its data-synthesis agent tries to import SDV's CTGAN synthesizer (via sdv.tabular) to generate synthetic patient records, falling back to Faker if SDV is unavailable.
